title: Puppy dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#E8A44A'/>
    <!-- belly lighter -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#F7DBA8'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='16' fill='#E8A44A'/>
    <!-- ear left -->
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='30' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#B06A2A' transform='rotate(-18 34 30)'/>
    <!-- ear right -->
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='30' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#B06A2A' transform='rotate(18 66 30)'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#F7DBA8'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='3.5' ry='2.6' fill='#4A2A1A'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='43' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#3A2010'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#3A2010'/>
    <circle cx='43.9' cy='29.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='57.9' cy='29.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- tongue -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#F06292'/>
    <!-- front leg left raised -->
    <rect x='30' y='56' width='7' height='15' rx='3.5' fill='#E8A44A' transform='rotate(-28 33 63)'/>
    <!-- front paw left -->
    <circle cx='26.5' cy='71' r='4.2' fill='#F7DBA8'/>
    <!-- front leg right -->
    <rect x='60' y='58' width='7' height='16' rx='3.5' fill='#E8A44A'/>
    <circle cx='63.5' cy='75' r='4.2' fill='#F7DBA8'/>
    <!-- back leg left -->
    <rect x='38' y='74' width='8' height='13' rx='4' fill='#C9853A'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='87' r='4.5' fill='#F7DBA8'/>
    <!-- back leg right kicked out -->
    <rect x='55' y='74' width='8' height='13' rx='4' fill='#C9853A' transform='rotate(20 59 80)'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='89' r='4.5' fill='#F7DBA8'/>
    <!-- tail wagging -->
    <path d='M69 55 Q80 48 78 60' stroke='#B06A2A' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- sparkles -->
    <path d='M22 20 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z' fill='#FFE680'/>
    <path d='M80 18 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z' fill='#FFE680'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='35' r='1.8' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='45' r='1.8' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
